name: Floating Panel
description: A non-modal panel anchored to a viewport corner for tools that coexist with the page.
usage: Panel content

anatomy.description: The non-modal surface pinned to a viewport corner; the page stays interactive behind it.
The title row with a close button, naming the panel for assistive technology.
The caller's companion content, like clipboard history or shortcuts.

dos: Use for companion tooling the user keeps open while working, like history or inspectors.
Pick an anchor corner that doesn't cover the page's primary navigation.
Keep the content compact; the panel has a fixed, viewport-capped width.
donts: Don't use it for decisions that need full attention; use Dialog.
Don't open several floating panels that overlap each other.
Don't put transient feedback in it; use Toast.

examples.title: Corner panel
examples.description: A closable panel floats above the page without trapping focus or dimming content.

examples.title: Alternate anchor
examples.description: The anchor prop moves the panel to any viewport corner.

guidance.useWhen: Companion tooling (history, shortcuts, inspectors) the user keeps open while working in the page.
guidance.avoidWhen: Tasks that demand full attention or decisions; use Dialog or BottomSheet instead.
guidance.behavior: Non-modal: the page stays interactive, focus is not trapped, and the panel closes via its close button or Escape.
guidance.responsive: Fixed width capped to the viewport with margins on every side, so it never covers edge-to-edge on phones.

keyboard.action: Closes the panel when focus is inside it.

notes: Renders as a non-modal role="dialog" named by its title; aria-modal is not set.
Because focus is not trapped, the panel participates in the natural tab order.

props.description: Viewport corner the panel is anchored to.
props.name: anchor

props.description: Accessible label for the close button.
props.name: closeLabel

props.description: Action area rendered at the bottom of the panel.
